challenges.name: validate-scan-log-lines
challenges.title: Validate the scan log without panicking
challenges.description: The nightly import lost a whole batch because one line of the scan log could not be parsed and the tool called unwrap(). Write parse_line(line: &str) -> Result<Scan, ScanError>, which splits a "<parcel id>,<route>,<weight in grams>" line, trims the fields and returns the first problem it finds: wrong number of fields, missing parcel id, a route that does not start with DN-, a weight that is not a u32, or a weight above 30000 g. ScanError and its messages are already written. The test runner prints every accepted or rejected line with its line number and a summary, so one bad line must never stop the batch.

tests.name: Example from the task: a garbled weight, a blank line and a foreign route
tests.expected:
line 1: SH10231 DN-07 1250 g
line 2: rejected: bad weight '12O0': invalid digit found in string
line 4: rejected: unknown route 'HA-01'
accepted: 1, rejected: 2, total: 1250 g

tests.name: Spaces around fields are trimmed; 30000 g is allowed, 30001 g and -5 are not
tests.expected:
line 1: SH10240 DN-11 30000 g
line 2: rejected: 30001 g is over the 30000 g limit
line 3: rejected: bad weight '-5': invalid digit found in string
accepted: 1, rejected: 2, total: 30000 g

tests.name: Two or four fields, a missing id and an empty weight
tests.expected:
line 1: rejected: expected 3 fields, found 2
line 2: rejected: expected 3 fields, found 4
line 3: rejected: missing parcel id
line 4: rejected: bad weight '': cannot parse integer from empty string
accepted: 0, rejected: 4, total: 0 g

tests.name: A bad route is reported before a bad weight; a weight too large for u32
tests.expected:
line 1: rejected: unknown route 'HA-01'
line 2: rejected: unknown route 'dn-07'
line 3: rejected: bad weight '99999999999': number too large to fit in target type
accepted: 0, rejected: 3, total: 0 g

tests.name: Blank lines still count for the line numbers
tests.expected:
line 1: SH1 DN-01 100 g
line 4: SH2 DN-01 200 g
line 5: SH3 DN-09 30000 g
accepted: 3, rejected: 0, total: 30300 g

tests.name: Only commas, only spaces and a lone id
tests.expected:
line 1: rejected: missing parcel id
line 3: rejected: expected 3 fields, found 1
line 4: SH10271 DN-04 0 g
accepted: 1, rejected: 2, total: 0 g
